summary: This beautifully presented three-bedroom mid-terrace property offers comfortable and spacious living, perfect for first-time buyers, growing families, or investors alike.
description:
LOUNGE Spacious lounge with a bay window providing plenty of natural light. Recently renovated, offering a bright and comfortable living space.

RECEPTION ROOM Second reception room with a window overlooking the rear yard. A versatile space ideal for use as a dining room or additional living area.

KITCHEN Modern renovated kitchen featuring wood-effect worktops and white wall and base units for a clean, contemporary look. Includes a fitted extractor fan with an electric hob, offering both style and practicality in a well-designed cooking space.

BEDROOM ONE Largest bedroom to the rear with fitted storage, window overlooking the rear yard

BEDROOM TWO Bedroom located to the front of the property, offering a bright and comfortable space with ample natural light. Ideal as a main bedroom or spacious guest room.

BEDROOM THREE Single bedroom ideal for a home office or spare bedroom.

BATHROOM Bathroom with white walls, featuring a bath, toilet, and sink.
